definition_zh: 辅导课；教程；导师个别辅导
definition_en: a small class taught by a tutor, or a self-study lesson that teaches a skill
core_image: 小教室里，导师和学生围坐一圈，逐段讨论作业
scene: 导师制下，学生每周写一篇短文，然后在课上当面讨论。At Oxford the student writes an essay and defends it in a tutorial.
sceneCN: 这里 tutorial 是「辅导课」（第 1 个义项：导师带少量学生上的讨论课）；句意：在牛津，学生写一篇短文，并在辅导课上答辩。

senses.title: A small teaching group
senses.definition: a class in which a tutor teaches a small number of students, often by discussion
senses.definitionCN: 由导师给少量学生上课、常以讨论方式进行的课
senses.example: We meet for a tutorial every Tuesday.
senses.exampleCN: 我们每周二上一节辅导课。
senses.why: Latin tueri means to watch over, so a tutor is a guardian who looks after learners, and the class that tutor leads is a tutorial.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 tueri 意为看守，导师就是「照看学习者」的人；他带的这门小课因此叫 tutorial。

senses.title: A one-to-one session
senses.definition: a lesson given to one student or a very small group by a tutor
senses.definitionCN: 导师给一名学生或极少数学生单独上的课
senses.example: She booked a tutorial to go over her draft.
senses.exampleCN: 她预约了一次个别辅导，用来讨论自己的草稿。
senses.why: The same word covers the private session in which one learner is watched over closely.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也指「被照看得很紧」的一对一辅导时段。

senses.title: A self-study guide
senses.definition: a lesson or set of instructions that teaches a skill, often on a computer
senses.definitionCN: 教人掌握某项技能的一课或一套说明，常用于电脑软件
senses.example: The software comes with a short tutorial.
senses.exampleCN: 这款软件附带一份简短的教程。
senses.why: Modern use borrows the teaching image for a guide that walks a learner through a task.
senses.whyCN: 现代用法借「教学」的意象，指一步步带学习者完成任务的指南。

senses.title: Relating to a tutor
senses.definition: connected with a tutor or with teaching done by tutors
senses.definitionCN: 与导师有关、或与导师授课方式有关的
senses.example: The college runs a tutorial system for first-year students.
senses.exampleCN: 学院为一年级学生实行导师制。
senses.why: The adjective keeps the plain link to the tutor and to the act of looking after a learner.
senses.whyCN: 形容词用法保留着与导师、与「照看学习者」这一动作的直接联系。

intro.en: Tutorial is built on Latin tueri, to watch over, through tutor and the suffix -ial.
intro.cn: tutorial 建立在拉丁语 tueri（看守、照看）之上，经 tutor 加后缀 -ial 构成。

items.en: Tueri means to watch over, guard or protect.
Tutor names the guardian who protects a person or property.
items.cn: tutor 指保护某人或其财产的监护人。

items.en: Tutor enters English as a guardian and later as a teacher.
items.cn: 十四世纪起，tutor 进入英语，先指监护人，后指教师。

items.en: Tutorial appears as an adjective meaning of a tutor.
items.cn: 十六世纪出现形容词 tutorial，意为「导师的」。

items.en: Tutorial becomes a noun for a small teaching group at a university.
items.cn: 十九世纪起，tutorial 成为名词，指大学里的小班辅导课。

items.en: The word now also names self-study guides and software lessons.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词也指自学教程与软件课程。

note.en: Tutorial is tutor plus the suffix -ial, next to tutoring and tuition, and it sits near the class words of a university.
note.cn: tutorial 是 tutor 加后缀 -ial，与 tutoring、tuition 形近，也与大学里的课程类词相邻。

entries.definition: a teacher of one or a few students
teaching, or the fee paid for it
a class for discussion in small groups
a formal talk given to a large class
a practical class for a skill

normalIntro.en: Tutorial carries the tutor inside it: a tutor watches over a few learners, and the class is the tutorial.
normalIntro.cn: tutorial 里面藏着 tutor：导师照看几个学生，这样的课就是辅导课。

normal.en: Tutor plus -ial gives tutorial, the class of a tutor.
normal.cn: tutor 加 -ial 就是 tutorial，即导师上的课。

normal.en: A tutorial group is small, so every student gets a turn to speak.
normal.cn: tutorial group 人数少，每个学生都有发言机会。

normal.en: An online tutorial walks a learner through a task.
normal.cn: online tutorial 一步步带学习者完成一项任务。

normal.en: Tuition is the teaching or the fee, tutorial is the class.
normal.cn: tuition 指教学或学费，tutorial 指那堂课。

normal.en: Compare lecture: a lecture is one voice to many, a tutorial is many voices to one.
normal.cn: 对比 lecture：讲座是一个声音对许多人，辅导课是许多声音对一个导师。

abstract.en: Picture a tutor and three students around one table.
abstract.cn: 想象导师和三名学生围着一张桌子。

abstract.en: Picture a tutor reading one essay with its writer.
abstract.cn: 想象导师和作者一起读一篇短文。

abstract.en: Picture a screen showing steps one, two and three.
abstract.cn: 想象屏幕上依次显示第一步、第二步、第三步。

examples.en: I have a tutorial with my supervisor on Thursday.
examples.cn: 我周四有一次和导师的辅导课。

examples.en: The online tutorial explains how to use the database.
examples.cn: 这份在线教程讲解如何使用该数据库。

examples.en: Tutorials at Oxford are built around the student essay.
examples.cn: 牛津的辅导课围绕学生写的短文展开。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「tutorial」读近「秋托瑞尔」——秋天把学业「托」给导师，上的就是辅导课；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 tueri（看守、照看）→ 拉丁语 tutor（保护人、监护人）→ 英语 tutor（导师）→ tutorial（导师带的课）；核心义「照看」：导师照看学生的学习。

sensesIntro.en: Tutorial starts as the small class led by a tutor, then covers the private session, the self-study guide, and the adjective that points back to the tutor.
sensesIntro.cn: tutorial 从小班辅导课开始，再指一对一的个别辅导、自学教程，最后是回指导师的形容词用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tutor sitting with a few students around one table.
core.cn: 核心意象：导师和几名学生围着一张桌子坐下。

branches.en: The small class is the university core.
branches.cn: 小班课是大学语境的核心义。

branches.en: The one-to-one session narrows the same scene.
branches.cn: 一对一时段把同一画面缩小。

branches.en: The self-study guide moves the scene onto a screen.
branches.cn: 自学教程把这一画面移到屏幕上。

branches.en: The adjective simply points back to the tutor.
branches.cn: 形容词用法只是回指导师。

branches.en: Both a group class and a private session are led by a tutor.
branches.cn: 小组课与个别辅导都由导师带领。

intro.en: Tutorial is built on Latin tueri, to watch over, through tutor and the suffix -ial.
intro.cn: tutorial 建立在拉丁语 tueri（照看）之上，经 tutor 与后缀 -ial 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin tueri means to watch over; tutor is the guardian, and tutela is protection.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tueri 意为看守；tutor 是监护人，tutela 是保护。

items.example: Tueri gives the image of watching over.

items.exampleCN: tutor 是拉丁语里的监护人。

items.example: Tutela names the act of protecting.

items.meaning: a teacher of one or a few students
items.example: Tutor shifts from guardian to teacher.
items.exampleCN: tutor 从监护人转为教师。

items.example: Tutorial is the class a tutor leads.
Tutorial also works as an adjective.

items.meaning: teaching, or the fee for it

items.exampleCN: tutelary 形容起守护作用的力量。
